_readme: Level 1 reward rules. Change any number here; it applies on the next Play.
passingPercent: the share of the level's maximum EXP AND maximum hearts needed to pass (unlock the next level). 100 = perfect run required.
requireSideQuestBeforeOffice: true = the receptionist, desk and case cannot be used until the side quest is finished.
conversation: hearts per finished plaza client conversation (bonus), and how many clients there are.
sideQuest: full EXP and hearts for a perfect corkboard; expPerWrong is taken off per wrong placement; a heart is lost at each count in heartsLostAtWrong (e.g. 1, 3, 5 wrong).
Badge tiers: finishing the side quest always earns the badge. Bronze = finished, Silver = side-quest EXP at or above passingPercent, Gold = perfect (no wrong placements). Replays keep the best tier.
badgeEmblem: the medal's centre picture (taxpayer_id, receipt, star). badgeRibbon: the ribbon colour (#RRGGBB). Give each side quest its own.
caseFile: full EXP and hearts per case for a first-try, mistake-free audit; per mistake the Auditor finds, and per extra submission (going back to redo), the amounts below are taken off.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
